concepts.title: Trumpet Orientation
concepts.summary: Identify the mouthpiece, valves, leadpipe, and a relaxed playing posture.

concepts.title: Embouchure Basics
concepts.summary: Shape the lips around the mouthpiece for a steady buzz.

concepts.title: Breath Support
concepts.summary: Breathe from the diaphragm and keep a steady column of air.

concepts.title: Valve Fingering
concepts.summary: Press the three valves in the combinations that produce each pitch.

concepts.title: Long Tones
concepts.summary: Sustain a steady tone with even air and a centred pitch.

concepts.title: Simple Articulation
concepts.summary: Start notes cleanly with a light "ta" tongue.

concepts.title: Major Arpeggios
concepts.summary: Play a C major arpeggio by combining valves, air, and articulation.

concepts.title: Simple Trumpet Melody
concepts.summary: Perform a short melody with accurate pitches and a steady pulse.

edges.rationale: A stable instrument position precedes lip placement.
The learner must know the valves before pressing them.
A sustained tone needs a formed embouchure.
Steady air is what makes the note last.
Long tones practise valve combinations under air.
Clean attacks build on a stable sustained sound.
Arpeggios are sustained pitches in sequence.
Each arpeggio note needs a clean start.
A melody combines the arpeggio's pitch accuracy with a pulse.
